messages:
devon: quick update from the v2q-lite canary on prod-slice A — some odd long-doc behavior.

nina: what's up?

devon: fidelity mostly fine (+0.4%), cost down ~22%, latency p95 +18ms. but hallucination_rate on docs >4k tokens jumped by ~1.7% absolute (2.8x).

ash: yikes. which slice?

devon: longdoc-heavy-rerank, ~3.6k samples. seems tied to quantized KV merge path when sequence >4096.

jia: did auto_fallback trigger? our gate is 1.0% delta.

devon: it didn't. root cause: telemetry tags those requests as "cold-kv-warmup" and they go through low-priority sampling without realtime hallucination metrics, so the fallback pipeline never saw the spike.

nina: that's a pipeline blindspot. we shouldn't promote cohorts without realtime quality hooks.

ash: short-term fix: exclude cohorts with realtime_quality=false from progressive promotion.

jia: also add a lightweight sentinel heuristic for long-doc hallucination so auto_fallback can act.

devon: implemented staging patch to exclude the cohort and added telemetry PR https://git.internal/r/telemetry/1234. staging tests green.

ash: long-term: change gating to hybrid absolute+relative thresholds and require 2 consecutive healthy windows to promote.

jia: ops: confirm revert playbook pins traffic to v2-stable and tags model with cohort label if fallback fires.
deploy-bot: scheduled config rollout dry-run at 02:15 UTC, will hold weights and report back. :gear:

devon: noted. adding onboarding checklist item: "no canary promotion for cohorts lacking realtime eval hooks". :memo:
